plugins.description: punkaze's agent skills collection. Ships bruno (author, generate, and run Bruno .bru API collections), hetzner-server-provision (provision a hardened Hetzner Cloud server end-to-end via the hcloud CLI), worktree-setup (config-driven git worktree setup with single/dual-repo scope splitting), free-disk-space (find reclaimable disk space on macOS/Linux and hand over copy-paste cleanup commands, read-only), and live-console (spin up a zero-dependency local web console from a declarative JSON spec for structured human review, with visual-first diagram/screenshot support).
